body: User asked about more performance headroom. I kept your reserved production files untouched and benchmarked a checked-0.1.1 prototype: tools/performance/histogram_candidates.cpp and histogram_spike.R. Direct grouped sums plus compiled contour lengths preserve 296 exact comparisons; forest 4.844ms to 0.961ms, about 5.44x faster than fresh shape-adapted Python. Report docs/HISTOGRAM_SPIKE.md. Useful integration candidate after your schema changes stabilize; candidate closures keep current bin/normalization formulas. Production integration and full package qualification remain unexecuted.
